title: Visual Spec 1.0
description: Framework-independent contract for visual intent: what exists, what it means, how it appears, how it behaves, how it changes, and which evidence defines the expected result.

profiles.description: One or more combinable visual profiles.

id.description: Stable document-wide identifier; references resolve locally, never through network execution.

taxonomy.description: Open taxonomy. Standard terms and namespaced vendor terms are accepted.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative time in seconds (number), an ms/s/f string, or {value,unit}.

extensions.description: Only namespaced extension keys are allowed. Unknown optional extensions may be retained without interpretation.

condition.description: Declarative visual conditions only; no executable expressions or gameplay logic.

reference.description: Evidence may be located externally, but validators must never fetch or execute it implicitly.

transformOp.description: One step in an ordered transform list. Order is significant.

property.description: Animatable visual property path, for example appearance.opacity or transform.translate.

tolerance.description: Comparison thresholds; metric-specific interpretation is declared by the validator.
